content.bridge_context: Discovering the valuable resources provided by our planet, such as air, water, soil, and minerals.

units.title: Natural Resources
units.explanation: Resources that exist in nature without any action of humankind.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name two things we get from the forest. / जंगल से मिलने वाली दो चीज़ों के नाम बताएं।

units.title: Renewable vs. Non-renewable
units.explanation: Some resources can be replaced (sunlight), while others cannot (coal).
units.dual_language_instruction: Will coal last forever? / क्या कोयला हमेशा रहेगा?
